rawInput: LibRaw existing linear ProPhoto D65, black/WB/camera matrix once
stageB: Optional SceneExposureV1 masked gain before original display shoulder/gamut/OETF; no clip in scene stage
displayLocal: Encoded sRGB D65 float ColorAdjustmentStack + LayerCompositeV1
fast: 800px cached area base then same frozen local point tools; bounded approximate display only
fine: Full effects then area integration in display-linear sRGB
export: Full-resolution original row/region pipeline to sRGB TIFF16/PNG16/JPEG8
versions: Old PV4/PV5/PV6 default new SceneExposure=null; no silent migration
ICC: General input/work/display/output ICC and wide gamut are B followups, not claimed complete
scientific: CalibrationEligible=false; same persisted output is consistency, not accuracy
